core: purposeful marking and notes during reading
annotation as a route to textual evidence

claims.claim: Annotation can include brief questions, ideas, underlining, circles, and symbols that help a reader engage with and revisit a text.
Highlighting without explanatory notes can become unhelpful when a reader returns to the text.
A small notation system can flag claims, evidence, questions, definitions, and key passages for later review.
Rereading and note-taking can support comprehension, clarification, and active engagement with a text.
Annotations assist analysis but do not replace returning to the original text as evidence for a claim.
